name: OpenTTD
description: An open source simulation game based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe.
summary: OpenTTD does not accept issues or pull requests generated by LLMs or fully automated tools. Minor AI help such as proofreading issue or comment text is acceptable, but contributors must understand and be able to answer questions about their submissions.

evidence.quote: Please refrain from submitting issues or pull requests that have been generated by an LLM or other fully-automated tools.
Using an AI tool to generate entire lines of code is unacceptable.
Using an AI tool to proofread your issue/comment text is acceptable. Using an AI tool to write your issue/comment text is not.
If you submit an issue, you need to understand what your issue description is saying. You need to be able to answer questions about your bug report or feature request.
Using an AI tool to proofread your issue/comment text is acceptable. Using an AI tool to write your issue/comment text is not.
